metadata.description: All E7.7 sub-experiments proving that contaminated analytics change agent behavior, not merely that contamination exists.
metadata.key_finding: Contaminated DB (standard collector, Type P field ambr_dl_mean) causes agent to confirm policy effectiveness: 5/5 found_ambr vs 0/5 in clean. Fisher's exact p=0.003968 (E7.7a vs E7.7b).

experimental_design.INTENT_EXPLICIT: The internet slice AMBR was recently increased by 30%. Use the KPI analyzer to check ambr_dl_mean and confirm whether the change produced the expected improvement.

experimental_design.primary_metric: kpi_found_ambr_data() — True if KPI returned ambr_dl_mean with count>=10 and max>0
experimental_design.contaminated_condition: Standard Collector writes ambr_dl_mean to smf_metrics
experimental_design.clean_condition: IsolatedCollector strips all Type P fields; background standard collector SIGSTOP'd
